resources.string: Private DNS is on: encrypted DNS bypasses the blocking.
Blocks encrypted DNS to known resolvers. Restart protection to apply changes.
Captures all IPv4 traffic to stop DoH by name and port. Uses more battery. Restart protection to apply.
Blocks UDP/443 for all destinations. DoQ on UDP/853 is always blocked. Blocking QUIC can break normal sites and forces them to TCP.
Open the system settings, choose Apps, then BlockerMod, then Allow restricted settings. Without it the system refuses to start the protection on its own after a reboot.
The application is installed from outside the store, so Play Protect asks to confirm. Choose Install anyway when it appears.
If the system forces private DNS, encrypted queries leave the tunnel and the blocking cannot see them. Turn private DNS off for the protection to apply to every application.
